## 📋 Overview

**Manwin's traps** is a powerful and configurable trap plugin that allows players to create explosive traps on both **blocks** and **entities**. Perfect for survival servers, minigames, or just having fun with friends!

### ✨ Key Features

- 🧱 **Block Trapping** - Place traps on chests, furnaces, doors, and any interactive block
- 👤 **Entity Trapping** - Trap players, mobs, and even your friends! (if you're evil 😈)
- 💥 **Configurable Explosions** - Customize power, fire, and damage settings
- 🔴 **Visual Glow** - Red glow/particles visible only to the trap owner
- ✂️ **Defusing System** - Safely remove traps with shears
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** - Everything is customizable via config.yml
- 🎮 **No Commands Needed** - All actions are done through simple interactions

---

## 🎮 How It Works

### Block Traps
| Action | Result |
|--------|--------|
| **Sneak + Right Click** with TNT | Places a mine on the block |
| **Right Click** on trapped block | 💥 BOOM! Explosion |
| **Left Click** on trapped block | 💥 BOOM! Explosion (block doesn't break) |
| **Right Click with Shears** | ✅ Defuses the mine |

### Entity Traps
| Action | Result |
|--------|--------|
| **Sneak + Right Click** with TNT on entity | Places a mine on the entity (glowing red) |
| **Hit** the trapped entity | 💥 BOOM! Entity explodes |
| **Hit with Shears** | ✅ Defuses the entity mine |
| **Entity dies** from any cause | 💥 BOOM! Explosion on death |

---
## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Download the latest release
2. Place in `plugins/` folder
3. Restart server
4. Sneak + Right Click with TNT on any interactive block or entity
5. Watch things explode! 💥

## ✨ Features

- **Block Trapping** - Chests, furnaces, doors, and more
- **Entity Trapping** - Players, mobs, and creatures
- **Visual Glow** - Red particles/glow visible only to owner
- **Defusing System** - Remove traps safely with shears
- **Death Explosion** - Trapped entities explode when killed
- **Full Configuration** - Customize everything in config.yml
